theme.rationale: Dark mode emphasizes the vibrant colors and holographic nature of trading cards, while presenting a serious, premium 'fintech' aesthetic suited for tracking real-market monetary values and misprint investments.

headings.usage: H1-H4, major section titles. Must use tracking-tight and avoid generic bolding. Use font-light or font-black for tension.

data_and_numbers.usage: All monetary values, prices, card numbers, stats, and historical data points. Reinforces the data-driven 'fintech' feel.

colors.archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY & ARCHETYPE 7: ELECTRIC (Blended for Collectibles)
rules: Never use pure black or pure gray. Always tint backgrounds slightly with blue or purple.
Use holographic_gradient sparingly: only for text clipping on 'Misprints' or 'Special Cards' highlights, or as a 1px glowing border on rare card containers.
Primary CTA buttons use the primary_accent (Volt Gold) for high visibility against the dark theme.
All text must meet minimum APCA contrast ratios. Normal text over 4.5:1, large text over 3:1.

surfaces: Dashboard widgets and normal cards: Flat Solid (Surface Elevated #1C1C21) with 1px border (#27272A), no heavy shadows. Radius: rounded-xl.
Sticky Navs/Modals: Crystal Glassmorphism. bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-xl, border-b border-white/10.
Rare/Special Card Highlights: The 'Tracing Beam' effect or a subtle 1px holographic border gradient to signify high-value items.
motion: Card Hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-2), scale up (scale-105), and a dynamic glare/sheen effect overlay traversing the card.
List Entrances: Staggered fade-up for collection grid items.
Hover states: All buttons and interactive rows must have distinct, lighter background hover states.

dashboard_overview.configuration: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, gap-4 or gap-6
dashboard_overview.span_logic: Total Value widget spans 1 or 2 cols. Main Value Over Time chart spans col-span-2 row-span-2 or col-span-3. Recent acquisitions as a narrow vertical list (col-span-1 row-span-2).

collection_grid.rules: Each card container must have negative space around the image. Cards should maintain exact aspect ratios of standard TCG cards (approx 2.5 : 3.5).

layouts_and_grids.spacing_philosophy: Generous Spacing (Tailwind Scale). Use p-6 to p-8 inside cards, keeping tight gaps (gap-4) between the cards to balance density with breathing room.

custom_html_tailwind: Pokemon Card displays (needs custom 3D tilt and glare overlays, Shadcn cards are too rigid).
Special Card Highlights and Misprint showcase widgets.
shadcn_ui: Dialog (for Add-to-Collection Modal with photo upload).
Select (for Card Condition: Mint, NM, LP, etc.).
Tabs (for switching between Dashboard, Collection, Wishlist).
Input / Command (for Pokemon TCG API card search autocomplete).
Chart (for Portfolio Value over time, powered by Recharts).

libraries_and_tools.charts: recharts (integrated via Shadcn Chart component) - use dark theme tooltips and stroke colors matching the primary accent.
libraries_and_tools.motion: framer-motion (for card tilt effects, page transitions, and staggered grid loading).
libraries_and_tools.notifications: sonner (for success/error toasts when adding/removing cards).

image_urls.description: Use as a very low opacity (10-20%) background image inside the 'Top Valuable Cards' or 'Misprints' container to give a shiny foil vibe.
Use for the 'Empty Collection' state or dashboard hero banner, heavily darkened with an overlay.
Use as a placeholder graphic for the 'Wishlist' section header or onboarding screen.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over holographic gradients has sufficient text-shadow or a dark backing pill.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (Add button, search input, condition dropdown, specific card clicks) MUST have a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='add-card-button', data-testid='search-api-input').
accessibility_and_testing.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the 3D card tilts.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use generic centered layouts. Ensure all dashboards and grids are left-aligned or optically aligned.
Integrate standard Pokemon TCG API endpoints for card search. The user wants to easily detect the card (show high-res card images in the search dropdown).
Prioritize the monetary value display. Real-money numbers should use the IBM Plex Mono font, colored in Gold/Volt or Success Green to trigger a dopamine response.
Build a specific section for 'Misprints / Special Cards' that highlights market anomalies. Make this visually distinct with a subtle holographic border.
Use Phosphor icons. You must install the package: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react
For the Add Card modal, include a file input for 'Photo Upload' and inputs for Condition (Mint, NM, etc.), Quantity, and Purchase Price.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds for Modals or Dropdowns; apply a solid dark background (#121215) or heavy backdrop-blur.
Install and use framer-motion for micro-interactions on the card grids.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠💭) for icons. Use Phosphor icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image_urls.
